unit_cn: Unit 2 Exploring English 探索英语
source: 外研社(新标准)必修第一册 Unit 2 词表(p14-24 真词;课标词优先,跳过专有名词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、探索英语/构词法/英美英语/网络用语主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Look at the title before you read the whole passage.
words.example_cn: 读全文之前先看标题。

words.example_en: English is a unique language full of surprises.
words.example_cn: 英语是一门充满惊喜的独特语言。

words.example_en: Try a creative way to remember new English words.
words.example_cn: 试试用有创意的方法记英语单词。

words.example_en: English reflects the creativity of the people who use it.
words.example_cn: 英语反映了使用它的人们的创造力。

words.example_en: The words we choose often reflect the way we think.
words.example_cn: 我们选用的词常常反映我们思考的方式。

words.example_en: There are several types of word formation in English.
words.example_cn: 英语里有好几种构词法类型。

words.example_en: When you meet an unfamiliar word, try to guess its meaning.
words.example_cn: 遇到陌生单词时,试着猜出它的意思。

words.example_en: A penfriend is a friend you contact by writing letters.
words.example_cn: 笔友是你通过写信联系的朋友。

words.example_en: WTO is short for the World Trade Organisation.
words.example_cn: WTO 是世界贸易组织的缩写。

words.example_en: A word known by many people is likely to enter the dictionary.
words.example_cn: 为众人所知的词很可能被收入词典。

words.example_en: Even small words can be confusing for English learners.
words.example_cn: 即使小词也可能让英语学习者困惑。

words.example_en: You can often guess a word's meaning from the context.
words.example_cn: 你常常能从语境猜出一个词的意思。

words.example_en: When the stars are out, they are visible in the night sky.
words.example_cn: 星星出来时,在夜空中清晰可见。

words.example_en: An alarm is only heard once it goes off.
words.example_cn: 警报器只有响起来才听得到。

words.example_en: Shameless and shameful behaviour can mean almost the same thing.
words.example_cn: shameless 和 shameful 形容的行为几乎一样。

words.example_en: "Hardly" and "softly" are not an opposing pair, though they look like one.
words.example_cn: hardly 和 softly 看似相反,其实并不是一对反义词。

words.example_en: We sculpt a sculpture but we take a photo.
words.example_cn: 我们 sculpt 出一件雕塑,却是 take 一张照片。

words.example_en: The artist made a beautiful sculpture out of stone.
words.example_cn: 那位艺术家用石头做出了一件美丽的雕塑。

words.example_en: Funnily enough, there is no ham in a hamburger.
words.example_cn: 有趣的是,hamburger(汉堡)里并没有 ham(火腿)。

words.example_en: Strangely, we don't feel homesick when we get back home.
words.example_cn: 奇怪的是,回到家时我们并不感到 homesick。

words.example_en: Americans take the subway, but the British travel on the underground.
words.example_cn: 美国人坐 subway(地铁),英国人坐 underground。

words.example_en: In the US people drive along the highway, while in the UK they use the motorway.
words.example_cn: 在美国人们沿 highway 开车,在英国则走 motorway。

words.example_en: Americans put gas in their cars, but the British call it petrol.
words.example_cn: 美国人给车加 gas,英国人却叫 petrol。

words.example_en: In the UK, drivers put petrol in their cars.
words.example_cn: 在英国,司机给车加 petrol(汽油)。

words.example_en: Americans live in an apartment, while the British live in a flat.
words.example_cn: 美国人住 apartment,英国人住 flat。

words.example_en: She rents a small flat near the city centre.
words.example_cn: 她在市中心附近租了一套小 flat(公寓)。

words.example_en: I went to a downtown shopping centre to buy some winter boots.
words.example_cn: 我去市中心的购物中心买冬靴。

words.example_en: I asked a lady at the entrance where the shoe section was.
words.example_cn: 我在入口处问一位女士鞋区在哪里。

words.example_en: The shoe section turned out to be downstairs, not upstairs.
words.example_cn: 鞋区原来在楼下,而不是楼上。

words.example_en: While looking for the exit, I finally saw the shoes.
words.example_cn: 在找出口时,我终于看到了那些鞋。

words.example_en: The shoes were actually sold downstairs on the ground floor.
words.example_cn: 鞋其实是在楼下的一层卖的。

words.example_en: She visited New York to buy some warm winter boots.
words.example_cn: 她去纽约买几双暖和的冬靴。

words.example_en: "A frog in one's throat" means you can hardly speak, not that you ate a frog.
words.example_cn: "喉咙里有只青蛙"指说话困难,而不是真吃了 frog。

words.example_en: I found it very odd that he called his kind grandfather "wicked".
words.example_cn: 他把和蔼的祖父说成"wicked",我觉得很 odd(奇怪)。

words.example_en: Why would my friend use a negative word about such a nice man?
words.example_cn: 我朋友为什么用一个负面的词来形容这么好的人?

words.example_en: I was looking forward to a positive comment on my paper.
words.example_cn: 我盼着论文得到一句正面的评论。

words.example_en: There weren't any errors in my English paper at all.
words.example_cn: 我的英语论文里一个错误都没有。

words.example_en: These funny stories remind us how strange English can be.
words.example_cn: 这些有趣的故事提醒我们英语有多奇怪。

words.example_en: Classroom English is often rather different from real-world English.
words.example_cn: 课堂英语常常和真实英语相当不同。

words.example_en: Online forums can be a very useful learning resource.
words.example_cn: 在线论坛可以是非常有用的学习资源。

words.example_en: Each post shared a funny misadventure with the English language.
words.example_cn: 每个帖子都分享了一段和英语有关的倒霉趣事。

words.example_en: In British English, "first floor" actually means the floor above the ground.
words.example_cn: 在英式英语里,first floor 实际上指地面以上的一层。

words.example_en: Make sure your abbreviations say what you intend to say.
words.example_cn: 确保你的缩写表达的正是你打算说的意思。

words.example_en: "Wicked" can be an informal word that means "fantastic".
words.example_cn: wicked 可以是个非正式的词,意思是"棒极了"。

words.example_en: By now I can recognise the differences between American and British English.
words.example_cn: 现在我能辨认出美式和英式英语的区别了。

words.example_en: We can base a new word on a simpler word we already know.
words.example_cn: 我们可以以已知的简单词为基础造出新词。

words.example_en: Good learners are aware of the cultural differences behind words.
words.example_cn: 好的学习者会意识到词语背后的文化差异。

words.example_en: "Selfie" is a recent addition to English dictionaries.
words.example_cn: selfie 是英语词典里新增的词。
